This orphan branch holds project understanding for the gitboard repository.
It serves as the source of truth for the teaching story and architectural intent.
Context updates are submitted via PRs targeting this branch.
## Story vs Typology evidence
Root markdown files (`mission.md`, `architecture.md`, etc.) constitute the teaching story for gitboard.
`evidence/typology/` contains Typology seed evidence used for digest proposals (e.g., `architecture_brief.md`). These briefs are supplemental and do not represent the confirmed `.typology/` catalog or the primary teaching story.
